name: Hisense 7000-BTU DOE Vented Wi-Fi Smart Portable Air Conditioner
description: Beat the summer heat with a truly premium smart cooling solution! This powerful Hisense 7000-BTU (DOE) Portable Air Conditioner is a dream come true for both general users and smart home enthusiasts. It features seamless Wi-Fi connectivity and connects natively via the ConnectLife app. More importantly for power users, it has flawless local integration with Home Assistant (HA), allowing you to easily bridge it to Apple HomeKit for Siri voice control and advanced automation setup. Extremely efficient 3-in-1 design (Cool, Fan, Dehumidifier) with a top-mounted automatic oscillating vent. This unit is in pristine, near-new condition and works perfectly. Listed at close to original retail price due to its top-tier smart home capabilities and perfect state!
contact_note: Perfect working condition with window exhaust hose and original remote control included. Firmware is updated and ready to pair with your smart home network setup.
meta_description: Pre-owned Hisense 7000-BTU smart portable air conditioner in excellent condition. Features Wi-Fi connectivity, Home Assistant and HomeKit integration, original retail value.
name_zh: 海信 Hisense 7000-BTU 智能移动空调（支持 Wi-Fi / HA 与 HomeKit 智能联动）
